preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 2 <= n <= 100 and 1 <= q <= 100
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string and the number of queries are between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: s consists only of '0' and '1'
preconditions.description: The string s contains only binary characters.

preconditions.expression: for each query: 1 <= l_i < r_i <= n
preconditions.description: Each query specifies a valid range within the string.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: len(output) == q
postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.
Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: for each query: output[i] == 'YES' if there exists a good subsequence in s that is equal to s[l_i...r_i], else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output indicates whether a good subsequence exists for each query.
